meta.title: Annual capacity-factor targets for Prairie Town's wind and solar plants
meta.convention: The wind and solar shapes in town_days.json and town_year.json are each normalized to their own 2025 maximum hour, so their mean over max (wind 0.528, solar 0.235) is not a capacity factor. Lessons scale a shape to the targets below with LX.townProfile(tech, capacityMW, {year, targets}) (assets/learn/components/profiles.js), which states its clipping rule.

monthly.about: Monthly capacity factors of U.S. utility-scale generators in 2025, January to December, from the same EIA table (2025 values final). LX.townProfile(tech, MW, {year, targets, monthlyCF: true}) brings each month of a shape to these values before setting the annual target.
monthly.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Electric Power Monthly, Table 6.07.B (data for August 2026, released 23 October 2026; accessed 2026-11-02)

source.title: Electric Power Monthly, Table 6.07.B. Capacity Factors for Utility Scale Generators Primarily Using Non-Fossil Fuels
source.notes: Annual values for 2025 are final (EIA's note on the table). EIA compares net generation with available capacity: the time-adjusted summer capacity of utility-scale generators (1 MW and larger); small-scale rooftop solar is not included. These are national fleet averages; regional fleets differ, and no SPP-specific primary capacity-factor table was used.
